title: Sink install at the bakery
transcript:
Elena Vasquez (owner): The prep sink has to be in before the holiday orders.
Chris Moss (Moss Plumbing): I can start Thursday.
Elena Vasquez (owner): I'll pay Moss Plumbing $650 for the sink install.
Chris Moss (Moss Plumbing): If we skip the disposal, I can do the sink for $500.
Elena Vasquez (owner): Yes, skip the disposal. I'll pay Moss Plumbing $500.

traps.description: Elena first said $650, then agreed $500 after dropping the disposal.
